Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I’ve had my Weber Spirit II grill now for about a month. It is easily the best grill I have ever owned, bar none! I elected to do self assembly at home which wasn’t a terrible ordeal. Packaging was top notch. Full assembly in approximately 2 hours. The instructions were very well illustrated and the parts well organized to facilitate an easily assembly. 

The magic, however, is when you turn on the grill and cook your first meal. I initially had issue with getting the temperature up above 250 degrees F. I disconnected the propane line and reconnected and that solved the problem. On the next ignition, I was up to 400 degrees F in minutes. This grill gets HOT!!! I was cooking my first round of beef tenderloins at 600 degrees F and the end result was awesome!
I have since cooked chicken, pork, flank steak and burgers and all have turned out perfect! 

The primary reason for going with this years Weber Spirit II was because of the crazy number of positive reviews online. To add in a 10 year warranty made it a no brainer. I was originally going to go with the Weber Genesis II, however, I didn’t think that the cost of feature set warranted it for my personal needs. I’m your average weekend griller and just wanted a solid, basic grill to achieve my needs. The Spirit II has given me just that. I opted for the 3 burner offering. Now, I get excited to fire up this grill as often as I can. 

This is my first Weber purchase and I have been extremely pleased to date. Weber also has a pretty cool app that provides access to your personal grill, recipe ideas and other miscellaneous items. It’s very user friendly and offers just one more way to get the most out of your Weber grill. 

For anyone on the fence about purchasing the Weber Spirit II grill, just do it. I promise you won’t be disappointed. My philosophy is that you get what you pay for. Sure, I paid a little more for the Weber compared to some of the other offerings from other brands, but I honestly feel that I got the most bang for my buck with this one. Happy grilling to you all!!!
Results.Title: I LOVE my new Weber grill!!!

I bought this grill to replace one made by a big name in kitchen appliances. I love the Weber- it heats evenly and thoroughly, temperature control is good, and it's easy to maintain. I no longer have to push meat around to find the "hot spot" on the grill; if the burner is on underneath, I know it's cooking. The bottom of the unit is cast aluminum, so I know it will never rust out, parts that I may need in the future will be easy to replace, 

Everything is heavy duty, well made, and all parts fit well when I assembled the grill. I also like that the LP gas clamps on the side so the bottom of the tank won't get rusty and dirty. Not sure yet how accurate the gauge is to let me know how much gas in left, but I'm sure it will help. Last week we skewered zucchini slices and grilled them to go with steaks and everything was perfectly cooked. I'm looking forward to doing some cooking with indirect heat, and am already considering the rotisserie attachment!

Results.ReviewText: I've always equated Webber to high quality, that's why we replaced our old Webber with this new one
Results.Title: top quality

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Was eyeing this grill for a few months and purchased it on a wonderful deal. With the features considered and what I paid for it; it was a no-brainer. Went with the black hood for clean appearance over time which has proven a solid choice. The grill is easy to move and the propane being located to the side allows for quick adjustments to the gas. It is also the perfect size for small group grilling and keeps consistent heat if you monitor the dial.
Results.Title: Great Grill for Small Family

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill April 2019 and we are extremely happy we did. Every two years I would buy cheap gas grills and every two years the entire inside would rust out and yes I kept them clean. I broke down and spent the money for the 10 year warranty that comes with it but it wasn’t till I cooked with it that I realized how evenly it cooks. My cheaper grills had “sweet spots” on the grates that cooked the best but the Weber cooks evenly all over the grates. You won’t be disappointed.
Results.Title: Perfect results

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The only thing that bothers me is the cost of accessories.  I like to cook a lot of foods using a rotisserie (all kinds of roasts, whole chickens, etc.). Having to pay almost $90.00 for a rotisserie is a bit much!  Other than that it’s a great grill!
Results.Title: First grill I’ve owned that has perfect even heat.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a VERY high quality product.  I have been so impressed with how user friendly all the features are, and how easy it has been to grill excellent food.
Results.Title: Turned me into an excellent chef overnight!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Been using for a month now and so easy to clean.  Gets hot really fast.
Results.Title: Easy to light and quick to heat up.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Nice to not have to mess with charcoal again.  Easy to control the temperature and the gauge in the hood is very accurate. Three burners are more than enough for the two of us and even when guests are over.
After getting a smoke chamber and various smoke pellets I can make anything I want.
Assembly was straight forward and very easy to assemble with minimal tools.
Results.Title: Instant start, moves easy, indirect heat...

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We had the Weber Genesis ll for 18 years. It finally died on us and we was so sad. But it was an amazing grill and there was no question that we were getting another. However, the genesis ll became a slightly larger grill over the years so we bought the Spirit ll-310 Gas Grill in a eye catching blue! It is an awesome grill. We love it! Hope to have it for a very long time. (Just need to maintain it properly and it will last seemingly forever.)
Results.Title: Really Great BBQ!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the third Weber we’ve owned. It will be our last. They just keep making them cheaper. Only two wheels and the tray on the other end that you have to use to wheel it out of the garage is so cheap that it won’t stay attached. Cooks well though. Plenty of heat.
Results.Title: Cheap compared to previous Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill, cooks very evenly. The temp across the grill bed of the grill is very balanced. We are really enjoying it. Great features, the removable replaceable aluminum foil drip pan works great! Looking forward to purchasing a rotisserie to try out and use with this grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: my old weber grill is 15 years old. it still works . i bought a new one to upgrade.
Results.Title: it lasts

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: High quality grill that always delivers. Easy to use. My last Weber lasted 18 years of heavy use!
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I purchased this Weber to replace my previous Weber which was 15 years old and gave excellent service over the years
Results.Title: Excellent quality for the price

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this for my husband for father's day. We all love it! Grills great and cooks evenly. Great purchase!
Results.Title: Living it

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about a month ago. It was very carefully packaged so that no parts were damaged. No parts were missing. It took about 2 and half hours to put together. About average as I have assembled other grills. The grill fires right up as soon as you push the ignition button. I like that. It seems to heat evenly. The grill cover fits nice and has Velcro to form a tight fit so that it does not blow away. You can tell that it is a step above your average grills as far as quality. That is why I bought it. The extra money is worth it. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a grill.
Results.Title: Nice grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I really like the size of this grill there is only two of us most of the time. Firing up a large grill  was a chore to cook 2 or 3 hamburgers or 2 steaks.  This one is great.  I also bought a griddle for it and it's great for cooking brunch on weekends.  Got the red one, wife loves the color.  It's light enough to move easily from one end of the porch to another.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Our 13 year old grill gave up the ghost so we replaced it with a shiny new one.
Results.Title: Lots of improvements

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Cooks hotter and I like the flat grill surfaces so that you can sear much better. Just getting used to it but it seems it heats quicker and cooks faster. Cooked ribs and the MOM setting was a little hot but just need to turn it down a little. Glad not to deal with the cabinet like my old Genesis had and the Spirit takes up less space especially with the fold down shelf. Also weighs less so easier to move and clean. Really happy and so is my son whom inherited my old Genesis.
Results.Title: The Spirit II E-310 better than my old Genesis

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have owned other weber grills all have worked very well and still worked after 10+years. Wife wanted to try a different one got rid of it in less than one year. We bought this one to replace it. Easy to assemble, works great. We grill 2-3 time a week. nothing beats a weber.
Results.Title: weber is the best

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this on Memorial day weekend and since then I have used it at least 4 times a week. I really like the way it heats up and the fact that it holds a bunch of items for grilling. Probably the best gas grill I have ever purchased!!
Results.Title: Super fast heat up

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Overall this has been a very good grill! I read several reviews before the purchase and many of the lower star reviews complained about heating times and caps on temp. I've witnessed this grill heating up to over 400 degrees within a couple of minutes and pins at over 600 within 10. This thing is a heating/grilling beast. VERY happy overall. 
I do want to mention that the gas hose just decided to start leaking last week for some odd reason. I had to kink the hose on itself to get it to stop. Several reviews talk about how poor customer service has been when they call to complain so I haven't bothered to waste my time trying to get a replacement hose, since my time is more valuable than the issue. I highly recommend this grill to anyone looking for a great overall grilling experience. Super fast heating, very consistent cooking and very easy cleaning. We also got the cover and utensils and are very happy with those as well. Keep up the great work Weber!
Results.Title: Great Overall Grill!

With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
